Load packages and read in files
```{r}
# Start with a clean slate
rm(list=ls())

# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)

# Read in files
folder <- "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/coverm_by_culture"

files <- list.files(
  path = folder,
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

data_list <- lapply(files, function(f) {
  
  dat <- read.delim(
    f,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep only Genome + the 2 measurements
  dat <- dat[, 1:3]
  
  # Give the columns consistent names
  colnames(dat) <- c(
    "Genome",
    "Mean",
    "Covered_Fraction"
  )
  
  dat
})

names(data_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files))

# Combine all
all_data <- bind_rows(data_list, .id = "Culture")

# Remove "coverm_" from the Culture names 
all_data <- all_data %>% mutate( Culture = sub("^coverm_", "", Culture) )

```



Include genus
```{r}
# Read GTDB file
gtdb <- read.delim("D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/metabolic_output/339genus/gtdbtk_Genome_files/classify/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv", header = TRUE)

# Extract genus name from classification string
gtdb$genus <- sub(".*;g__([^;]+).*", "\\1", gtdb$classification)

# Add genus to coverm data
all_data <- all_data %>%
  left_join(
    gtdb %>% select(user_genome, genus),
    by = c("Genome" = "user_genome")
  )


# Clean up genus classifications
all_data <- all_data %>%
  mutate(
    genus = case_when(
      
      # If genus is missing, extract the family name from the classification
      grepl(";g__;s__", genus) ~ sub(
        ".*;(f__[^;]+);g__;s__.*",
        "\\1",
        genus
      ),
      
      # Otherwise keep the genus as-is
      TRUE ~ genus
    )
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Genus = genus
  ) %>%
  
  # Remove CoverM "unmapped" rows
  filter(
    !grepl("unmapped", Genome, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )
```


Make csv
```{r}
write.csv(all_data, "D:/Planktothrix_microbiomes/manuscript_figures/supplemental/coverm339.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
